notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, a new update for the game has just been released. 

What's new?
- Added a double check for boss rooms in the second Chapter
- Tweaked enemy placement even further
- Finetuned the hit detection even more
- Some graphical upgrades in the backgrounds

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Citadale - The Legends Trilogy has been recently updated. 

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in keyboard mode that stopped a cutscene
[*]Added save states: Press F1 or the left analog stick to save a state and press F2 or the right analog stick to load a savestate. 
[i]Note: Savestates are universal so it's ONE savestate for all three chapters![/i][/list]

tags.bug: [*]Fixed a bug in keyboard mode that stopped a cutscene

tags.feature: [*]Added save states: Press F1 or the left analog stick to save a state and press F2 or the right analog stick to load a savestate.
